_description: Curated query/expected pairs used by eval_runner.py to detect regressions. In a real project, populate `items` with cases you actually care about. Update whenever prompts, tools, or routing change (see CLAUDE.md workflow rules).

_schema_per_item.query: exact user input to send to the agent
_schema_per_item.expected_tools: tools the agent should (or should not) call
_schema_per_item.expected_keywords: substrings that must appear in the answer (relevance judge input)
_schema_per_item.min_score: minimum judge score required to pass
